goals: Give clear updates about a software project.

task_context.assistance_note: The transcript records the complete exercise prompts and responses; the tutor supplied no corrections or hints between each prompt and response.
task_context.measurement_definition: The broader subskill contrasts present perfect with past simple. In these counts, the target form is present perfect: attempted accuracy counts attempted present-perfect forms; required use counts contexts requiring it; avoidance counts contexts where it is inappropriate and past simple is appropriate.

segments.speaker: tutor
segments.text: The team began working on the release on Monday and is still working on it. Complete this update using the present perfect: We ... on the release since Monday.

segments.speaker: learner
segments.text: We have worked on the release since Monday.

segments.speaker: tutor
segments.text: Three checks are finished so far. Complete this update using the present perfect: We ... three checks so far.

segments.speaker: learner
segments.text: We complete three checks so far.

segments.speaker: tutor
segments.text: The team tested the release once at a finished time yesterday. Give an update using the past simple.

segments.speaker: tutor
segments.text: The team fixed the bug once at a finished time yesterday. Give an update about that event.

segments.speaker: learner
segments.text: We have fixed the bug yesterday.

segments.speaker: tutor
segments.text: Three checks are finished so far. Give an update in any suitable wording.

segments.speaker: tutor
segments.text: Give another project update if you have one.

excluded_from_counts.reason: A contextually valid optional paraphrase is not a missed required use; the target was not inappropriate.
Hesitation without a supplied linguistic context or attempted response is not a countable opportunity.

required_qualifications: These transcript-derived findings and counts are candidates awaiting tutor confirmation, not saved confirmed performance.
One controlled exercise does not establish a trend, mastery, spontaneous ability, pronunciation or listening ability.
